description: Held-out evaluation of the external-review adoption program. dev: the core five, the only commons-ten-v1 buildings ever run through SfM (v0 and v1 results). test: the five never run. synthetic-v1 and mdx-two-v1 are dev data as a whole (mdx-two-v1's photos are inside the dev buildings: Baptistery 20 of 20, Aachen 14 of 29 by Commons title).
rules: Run test only with a frozen commit and config named in advance: the baseline B0 and the frozen candidate F. Every test run is kept.
A code or parameter change prompted by a test result burns that building: the split gets a new version that marks it.
Report the contamination below with every test result.

photographers.rule: Per-photo metrics on test buildings are reported for all test photos and for the photos by unseen photographers; a photo without an author identity counts as neither seen nor unseen.

sessions: A session is one (author, capture day) as in scripts/eval_real_landmark.py plan_arrival. The last 30% of a building's sessions in arrival order are late: their photos arrive while a model of the building exists, and incremental-map comparisons are judged on them.
contamination: The structure rules were set on the 13 catalog snapshots, which include the five test buildings: G3 (part filter) from the Lincoln Memorial terrace, G10 (support) from India Gate (docs/STRUCTURE_FIRST.md section 2.8), the ticket thresholds of crowd3d/structure.py on all 13.

The photo-pose EXIF position sigma (crowd3d/photoposes.py) was calibrated on 51 photos that include the five test buildings, scored EXIF-only (docs/BENCHMARK.md section 7.7): EXIF uncertainty coverage on test is not out of sample.

India Gate's reference: 12 of its 41 cameras sit near the point reflection of their own EXIF GPS through the landmark centre (docs/BENCHMARK.md section 7.7); its verdicts are reported separately, outside the pooled numbers.
14 photographers appear in both splits; they took 53 of the 513 test photos.
